title: RAID HUD HAS ONE HERO
why: UI step 3 of the HUD hierarchy job (103). The critic: the extraction banner lacks hero weight and the keys sheet is always on at full strength. While the extraction ship is inbound the ammo card drops to 60 percent so the countdown line is the hero; the compact controls list is drawn at 80 percent so it reads as a reference. Ammo stays the hero in a fight. Nothing moves, no draw call added. Watch: the ammo card looks faded for the 15 to 30 seconds of the inbound countdown; the controls list on the first raids is quieter.
now: While you wait for the extraction ship the ammo card fades back. The controls list is a bit quieter.

edits.anchor: hudZoomIn('gear',W,H);                 // v8.08: grows up and left from the corner
